@0 n="covalent_overlap_load" d="Squared covalent overlap summed over occupied contacts per atom, with reduced overlap capped at three." B=841
def feature(s):
    if not s:
        return 0.0
    sites = s.get('sites') or []
    n = len(sites)
    p = s.get('element_properties') or {}
    radii = [(p.get(a.get('element')) or {}).get('covalent_radius_A') for a in sites]
    occ = [max(a.get('occupancy', 1.0) or 0.0, 0.0) for a in sites]
    weight = sum(occ)
    if weight <= 0:
        return 0.0
    total = 0.0
    for b in s.get('neighbors') or []:
        i = b.get('i', -1)
        j = b.get('j', -1)
        d = b.get('distance_A') or 0.0
        if 0 <= i < n and 0 <= j < n and d > 1e-8:
            ri = radii[i]
            rj = radii[j]
            if ri is not None and rj is not None and ri > 0 and rj > 0:
                overlap = min(max((ri + rj) / d - 1.0, 0.0), 3.0)
                total += occ[i] * occ[j] * overlap * overlap
    return total / (2.0 * weight)
@end
@1 n="valence_electron_density" d="H3-convention valence electron count per cubic angstrom." B=485
def feature(s):
    if not s:
        return 0.0
    v = s.get('volume_per_atom_A3')
    if v is None or v <= 0:
        return 0.0
    p = s.get('element_properties') or {}
    total = 0.0
    weight = 0.0
    for e, x in (s.get('composition') or {}).items():
        z = (p.get(e) or {}).get('valence_electrons')
        if x is not None and x > 0 and z is not None and z >= 0:
            total += x * z
            weight += x
    return total / (weight * v) if weight > 0 else 0.0
@end
@2 n="mean_atomic_charging_gap" d="Composition-weighted atomic ionization-energy minus electron-affinity gap." B=478
def feature(s):
    if not s:
        return 0.0
    p = s.get('element_properties') or {}
    total = 0.0
    weight = 0.0
    for e, x in (s.get('composition') or {}).items():
        a = p.get(e) or {}
        ie = a.get('first_ionization_energy_eV')
        ea = a.get('electron_affinity_eV')
        if x is not None and x > 0 and ie is not None and ea is not None:
            total += x * (ie - ea)
            weight += x
    return total / weight if weight > 0 else 0.0
@end
@3 n="octet_charge_balance_residual" d="Signed normalized residual of a group-based octet-charge heuristic; transition and f-block donor charges are capped at three." B=976
def feature(s):
    if not s:
        return 0.0
    p = s.get('element_properties') or {}
    total = 0.0
    scale = 0.0
    for e, x in (s.get('composition') or {}).items():
        if x is None or x <= 0:
            continue
        a = p.get(e) or {}
        g = a.get('group')
        en = a.get('eneg')
        v = a.get('valence_electrons')
        row = a.get('row')
        q = None
        if g == 1 or g == 2:
            q = float(g)
        elif g == 13:
            q = 3.0
        elif g == 14:
            q = -4.0 if en is not None and en >= 2.3 else 4.0
        elif g is not None and 15 <= g <= 17:
            q = float(g - 18)
        elif g == 18:
            q = 0.0
        elif v is not None and ((g is not None and 3 <= g <= 12) or (g is None and row is not None and row >= 6)):
            q = min(max(v, 0.0), 3.0)
        if q is not None:
            total += x * q
            scale += x * abs(q)
    return total / scale if scale > 0 else 0.0
@end
